geometry.valid_inner: positive even count; hardware inner loop is P5>>1
geometry.valid_stride: even halfword stride for aligned dword source loads
geometry.source_phase1: R0 mod4 = 2 selects .L branch after +/-2-byte pointer correction
geometry.row_advance: 2*stride halfwords / 4*stride bytes between same-phase output rows
geometry.phase1_scratch: one additional write at out2_ptr-4 bytes before the formal logical output region
geometry.phase0_scratch: no extra write inside the observed pre-pointer guard
